name: motion-snap-in
title: Snap In
description: Sau cú bấm, một thẻ trượt 43 px vào chỗ thật nhanh rồi dừng gọn, có hai vệt tốc độ phía sau.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: A click on a button (button scale 1 → 0.94 in 60 ms, back in 140 ms power2.out) triggers a toast pill: x −43 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1 in 380 ms expo.out (bezier .16,1,.3,1), ~100 ms after the press; two short speed lines trail it and fade out by 90 % of the move. Exit: fade 250 ms. Tips: travel 0.5–1.5 object widths, 300–450 ms. Params: duration (0.38 s) · from (−43 px) · ease (expo.out) · lines: vệt tốc độ (bật/tắt).
